parent_objective: design a bounded offtrack repair route with collision guardrails from consolidated target artifacts
blocked_by: M2369 accepts target artifacts but no repair route is designed
ordinary offtrack targets require collision and R4 guardrail constraints before any repair materialization
supersedes: direct training from consolidated target artifacts
repair design that ignores collision guardrails or R4 semantics

public_gates: M2370 must define repair target, collision guardrail, R4, and diagnostic guardrail policies
M2370 must choose a bounded artifact-only repair-spec materialization route or stop the branch
M2370 must not run reset/rollout, train, rank, claim scenario redesign executed, or claim repair success
forbidden_shortcuts: do not rank support policies or controller families
do not overwrite the active scenario config
do not claim finite-window vs GRU conclusion
do not claim scenario redesign executed
do not claim training repair success

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: turns audited target/guardrail artifacts into a bounded repair design route
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: design only; no rerun, ranking, paper verdict, finite-window-vs-GRU, self-ID, scenario-redesign-executed, or training-repair claim
stop_condition: stop if repair targets cannot be separated from collision guardrails
stop if R4 mitigation semantics would be mixed into ordinary repair
stop if design routes directly to training or profile ranking
stop if design claims scenario redesign executed or repair success
fallback_plan: route to branch synthesis if repair route cannot be bounded
route to target-consolidation repair if input categories are insufficient
route to artifact-only repair-spec materializer if design is bounded
workflow_synthesis.synthesis_trigger: M2369 accepts consolidated target artifacts and requires bounded repair design

allowed_updates: M2370 status queue scoreboard research log and review
one follow-up manifest selected by the design
next_stage_criteria: ordinary offtrack repair policy is specified
R4 and diagnostic guardrail boundaries are specified
a bounded artifact-only materialization route is selected or branch is stopped

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: M2370 designs repair route and does not test history necessity.
history_necessity_tests: None in M2370; no wrong-history reset-hidden zero-history finite-window or GRU comparison verdict is run.
self_id_evidence_discipline.temporal_evidence_window: M2368 consolidated target artifacts and M2369 audit.
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: Repair design targets weak outcomes as engineering blockers, not ranking or self-ID evidence.
allowed_claims: no controller ranking, paper-level result, finite-window-vs-GRU result, scenario-redesign-executed result, training-repair result, or level3 self-identification claim

local_search_guard.evidence_expansion: prepares a bounded repair design from a consolidated measured target panel
local_search_guard.paper_verdict_delta: can admit repair-spec materialization but cannot establish paper verdict
must_synthesize_if: M2370 cannot specify a bounded repair route
M2370 proposes direct profile ranking or paper conclusion
the outcome-localization branch reaches 10 milestones without synthesis

hypothesis: A bounded repair design can target ordinary offtrack failures while preserving collision guardrails, R4 semantics, and diagnostic no-ranking boundaries.
success_criteria: ordinary offtrack repair targets and collision guardrails are specified
R4 mitigation and diagnostic guardrails remain separate
ranking, winner selection, paper-level, finite-window-vs-GRU, scenario-redesign-executed, training-repair, and level3 self-ID claims remain blocked
a bounded artifact-only repair-spec materializer route is selected or branch is stopped
failure_criteria: M2370 reruns reset rollout measured execution replay PPO or private holdout
M2370 ranks support policies or controller families
M2370 makes paper-level finite-window-vs-GRU or level3 self-ID claims
M2370 claims scenario redesign executed or training repair success
M2370 cannot separate offtrack targets from collision/R4/diagnostic guardrails

commands.name: design
commands.command: manual design from M2369 audit and M2368 consolidated target artifacts

decision_rule: M2370 passes if it defines a bounded non-ranking repair design and selects an artifact-only materialization route or stops the branch.
